in_marathi.name: Mamatha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mother of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mamatha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Mamatha refers to the mother of the universe and the goddess of nourishment and protection. She is also known as Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva.

in_bengali.name: Mamatha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Mother of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Mamatha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Mamatha refers to the mother of the universe and the goddess of nourishment and protection. She is also known as Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva.
